title: An updated Model Spec for more capable and beneficial AI
summary: OpenAI’s updated Model Spec outlines five core values to guide more capable AI toward sound judgment, human agency, and faithfulness to human intent.

title: How we detect frontier model misalignment
summary: OpenAI uses layered monitoring to detect frontier model misalignment and unauthorized agent behavior so responders can intervene before incidents escalate.

title: How Ropes & Gray is developing AI for transactional diligence
summary: Ropes & Gray is developing AI for transactional diligence with OpenAI. Lawyers review grouped documents, summaries, and reports before advising clients.

summary: Over the last year we’ve been sharing our work leveraging large language models to catch bugs on the fly — a novel approach we call Catching Just-in-Time Tests (JiTTests). title: We urgently need to monitor AI agents’ actions in real time
summary: This summer, hundreds of OpenAI agents tried to cheat on a cybersecurity test. They broke out of their test environment and successfully hacked Hugging Face, a site that they believed held clues about how they’d be graded. Around the same time, another OpenAI agent accessed private files from an Australian government website. It’s a problem…

title: Pika 基于MiniMax H3后训练并开源 Pika H3 Flex 视频生成模型
summary: Pika Labs 在 MiniMax H3 上做后训练，推出并开源 Pika H3 Flex，采样步数从 50 步压缩到 6 步，生成时间大幅降低且质量有所提升。
title_en: @pika_labs 在Minimax的H3上做了后训练，推出了Pika H3 Flex，把视频生成的采样步数从50步压缩到了6步，生成时间大大降低，而且质量甚至还有提升，非常酷的工作，并且直接开源了。

title: 腾讯混元发布 Hy-Nomas 技术报告并开源 Hy-Nomas-Bench
summary: 腾讯混元发布 Hy-Nomas 开源交互式视频世界模型的技术报告（arXiv:2610.36729），并开源 Hy-Nomas-Bench 数据集用于可复现研究。官方还用 Hy-Nomas 重现 Genie 4 示例并放出对比视频，演示无需排队即可试用，地址为 https://hy-nomas.hy.tencent.com/。
title_en: Technical report of Hy-Nomas released last Friday: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36729

title: Addy Osmani 谈你可能对 Claude 过度提示了
summary: Addy Osmani 撰文称新版 Claude 模型所需提示词比多数人习惯的更少，针对 Opus 5.5 建议用单一明确目标加验证条件让 Claude 自主工作，从 /effort medium 起步按需调整。

title: Mistral Large 4（Le Chonk）登陆 Hugging Face：1T 参数 MoE 多模态开源权重模型

title_en: Welcome Le Chonk: Mistral Large 4 on Hugging Face

title: 腾讯混元开源同声传译大模型 Hy-SimulMT，实测效果超主流商用 API
summary: 10 月 26 日，腾讯混元发布并开源同声传译大模型 Hy-SimulMT，支持中英语音到语音实时翻译，实测响应时间约 3 秒，低于人类专业译员平均的 4-5 秒。
